rationale.al-barsha: Nearest to the beach corridor while still on the metro network; taxi trips are longer, but it satisfies the beach interest without breaking the budget.
rationale.al-fahidi: Excellent walkability to cultural sites (Al Fahidi, Al Seef, Old Souk) and good metro; taxi time to food/beach spots is the lowest of the list.
rationale.al-karama: Central location with cheap South‑Asian eateries and easy metro to the Dubai Frame; slightly longer taxi rides but still budget‑friendly.
rationale.al-ras: Close to historic souks and an abra crossing gives a scenic, low‑cost link to Bur Dubai; metro access is solid and taxi time is comparable to al‑fahidi.
rationale.al-rigga: Cheapest nightly rates and Red Line metro, but the highest taxi travel time to cultural and beach destinations.

rationale.dubai-marina: Beachfront vibe and tram/metro links, but higher taxi minutes to cultural spots and a higher price band.
rationale.jumeirah: Prime beach setting and family‑friendly low‑rise vibe, but lacks metro and costs more, requiring taxis for most trips.
